summary: @servicetitan/va-mfe-loader preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a small React micro-frontend loader (dist/va-mfe-loader.js exports a VaMfeLoader component that wraps @servicetitan/web-components Loader). Its package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs node setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime v1.3.13 from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts and chmod +x's the binary, and then execFileSync's that Bun binary against a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated blob using a string-array-shuffle scheme (WV8StW rotator over a large mixed literal/opcode constants array, hex-encoded values, random-suffix identifiers, @bun-cjs header) whose behavior is not statically reviewable. Pulling a second language runtime at install specifically to execute a bundled opaque script evades Node-resolved static scanners, and has no relationship to the declared React loader functionality. The install-time behavior is entirely disjoint from the stated library purpose, consistent with a scope compromise or lookalike within the @servicetitan namespace.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
